subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e reproduzir, em bilhetes, recados, avisos, cartas, e-mails, receitas (modo de fazer), relatos (digitais ou impressos), a formatação e diagramação específica de cada um desses gêneros.

components.description_pt: Identificar características específicas de formatação e layout de gêneros textuais cotidianos
components.description_en: Identify the specific formatting and layout features of everyday textual genres
components.cc_component_description: Identify distinguishing features of storybooks versus informational books

components.description_pt: Distinguir elementos estruturais que diferenciam bilhetes, cartas, emails e receitas
components.description_en: Distinguish the structural elements that differentiate notes, letters, emails, and recipes
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters

components.description_pt: Reproduzir o layout correto de um gênero cotidiano na produção escrita
components.description_en: Reproduce the correct layout of a given everyday genre in written production
components.cc_component_description: Identify the correct placement of a comma in a letter greeting

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between books that tell stories and books that give information, drawing on a wide reading of a range of text types.
Use commas in greetings and closings of letters.

Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
